paragraphs.en: Six years ago, in the Sahara Desert, I faced a life-threatening situation after my plane's engine broke down. With no mechanic or passengers, I attempted repairs alone, relying on scarce drinking water for a week. On waking at sunrise, I was startled by an odd voice requesting a drawing of a sheep.
paragraphs.zh: 六年前，在撒哈拉沙漠中，我的飞机引擎突然故障，我面临生死攸关的困境。独自一人，没有任何机修人员和乘客的帮助，我只能依靠稀少的饮用水进行修理。直到日出时分醒来，耳边忽然传来一个奇怪的声音，要求我画一只羊。

paragraphs.en: I stood, utterly stunned, and blinked hard to focus. Before me stood a small figure, examining me with seriousness. Despite my lack of artistic skills, I drew the best portrait possible, though it fell short of its model's charm.
paragraphs.zh: 我愣在原地，努力眨了眨眼以集中视线。眼前站着一个小小的身影，正严肃地打量着我。尽管我没有多少绘画天赋，我还是尽力画出了最好的肖像，虽然这幅画远不及模特的魅力。

paragraphs.en: My inability to draw stemmed from adults discouraging my painterly ambitions when I was six. Now, staring at this apparition in astonishment, I questioned his presence. A thousand miles from any habitation, he seemed neither lost nor distressed.
paragraphs.zh: 我的绘画才能之所以缺失，源于六岁时成人对我的画图梦想的打压。此刻，我惊讶地盯着这个身影，不禁质疑他的出现。在这荒无人烟的地方，他既不显得迷失，也不见忧愁。

paragraphs.en: "Where are you from?" I asked, bewildered.
He repeated calmly: "Draw me a sheep..."
paragraphs.zh: 他平静地重复道：“给我画一只羊……”

paragraphs.en: In the face of such mystery, I hesitated but produced paper and pen. Remembering my focus on academic subjects, I gruffly told him I couldn't draw. He responded with patience.
paragraphs.zh: 面对这样的神秘情况，我犹豫了一下，但仍拿出了纸和笔。想起自己专注于学术科目，我粗声粗气地告诉他我不会画画。他则耐心地回应了我。

paragraphs.en: The boy asked, "Draw me a sheep..." but I had never drawn one. Instead, I drew the boa constrictor from the outside, which I had done many times before.
paragraphs.zh: 男孩说道：“给我画一只羊……”但我从未画过羊。相反，我画了那条蟒蛇的外貌，这是我以前做过多次的事。

paragraphs.en: "No, no, no!" he said. "I don't want an elephant inside that.
paragraphs.zh: “不，不，不！”他脱口而出，“我可不想里面有个大象。”

paragraphs.en: A boa constrictor is dangerous and an elephant is cumbersome. Where I live, everything is small. I need a sheep."
paragraphs.zh: 蟒蛇危险，大象笨拙。我住的地方，一切都小得可怜。我倒宁愿有一只羊。

paragraphs.en: I drew another one, but it was rejected because the sheep looked sickly. Then, he wanted a young sheep that would live long.
paragraphs.zh: 我又抽了一只，但被拒绝了，因为那只羊看起来病恹恹的。接着，他想要一只年轻健壮、能长寿的羊。

paragraphs.en: "This one is too old," he said. "I want a sheep that will live a long time."
paragraphs.zh: “这只太老了，”他说，“我要一只能活很久的羊。”

paragraphs.en: My patience ran thin as I hurried to take apart my engine. So, I drew another sheep and tossed it at him with an explanation: "This is only the box; the real sheep is inside."
paragraphs.zh: 我的耐心快被耗尽了，急忙拆解起机器来。于是，我又画了一只羊，并把它扔向他，解释道：“这只是个盒子，真正的羊在里边。”

paragraphs.en: His face lit up. "That's exactly what I wanted! Do you think this sheep will need much grass?"
paragraphs.zh: 他的脸上露出了笑容。“正是我想要的！你觉得这只羊需要很多草吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Because where I live everything is small..."
paragraphs.zh: “因为在我们那里，一切都显得很小……”

paragraphs.en: "It won't need much," I said, "it's a very small sheep." He studied the drawing closely: "Not so small that—Look! He’s sleeping..."
paragraphs.zh: “不需要太大,”我说，“这只羊很小。”他仔细研究着图纸：“不至于那么小——看！它在睡觉……”

paragraphs.en: And thus began my acquaintance with the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: 就这样，我与小王子结下了不解之缘。
